# AI Gateway v0.3.2

The PostgreSQL Helm chart now installs the JWT principal migration correctly.
Versions 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 placed its SQL under ConfigMap metadata, which Kubernetes
strict validation rejects and the migration runner cannot discover.

## Changes

- Place `013_jwt_principals.sql` in ConfigMap `data`. The additive SQL and existing
  directory records are unchanged.
- Require migration copies to appear in `data`; SQL under metadata or another
  top-level field no longer satisfies the regression checks.
- Require migration 013 in the PostgreSQL chart integration runner, so CI cannot
  pass with a missing identity migration.

## Upgrade

Use PostgreSQL chart 0.3.2 and apply its migrations before enabling directory JWT
identity. Existing deployments may apply the unchanged migration 013 directly.
Gateway/Auth behavior, legacy credentials and IdP trust settings are unchanged;
installing this patch does not enable directory mode or create user bindings.
